source: green bottle model interpreted from supplied photographs
AR: visible transparent bottle and plant share a bottle-mouth anchor; flower can be adjusted independently with joysticks
drink_option: Tap the camera image at the liquid surface, or use the centre marker. Manual distance and joysticks position a world anchor without a tabletop or detected glass surface. A hollow transparent AR tumbler replaces the green bottle overlay in this mode, with adjustable glass height, rim width and liquid level. The first growth is inside the glass below its rim; growth below the selected liquid plane is hidden.
ground_option: Third option: grow from a detected ground marker at its actual height, with underground growth clipped and no container overlay. Optional ground detection falls back to manual point placement if unavailable. Independent manual distance and ground cut-off preferences are saved. Existing joystick, growth, appearance and clean fullscreen controls are retained.
glass_visibility: Bottle and drink modes have an explicit Show AR glass switch and 5-100% visibility slider; default 35%. AR uses alpha glass because the phone camera is composited outside the optical transmission render target.
adjustments: plant starting height above bottle base
hide growth below soil or fabric wrap
textures: generated lifelike botanical surface atlas; see botanical-surfaces.json
suite_controls: Model exposure (-2 to +3 EV), plant size (10-1000%), plant transparency, independent Move speed (1/8-32x), Nearer/Farther, Face me, Stop, Projects/Models navigation, and both joysticks available with the menu open. Uses the established MAYHEM AR control conventions without modifying shared pages.
saved_settings: Glass calibration, growth speed, appearance and movement preferences are saved locally. World positions, anchors and running animation are not restored across sessions; a new real-world placement is required.
liquid_cutoff: Independent cut-off height, enable switch, optional guide, Set at plant base, and reset to the tapped liquid. The offset resets on new liquid selection; flower movement does not silently change the cut-off.
viewing: Playback remains available with the menu hidden, without top overlays. Grow full screen hides the HUD and guides, with tap-to-reveal controls. Preview uses the browser Fullscreen API; immersive AR keeps its existing fullscreen root.
validation: WebGL and emulated WebXR checked; latest fixes await physical phone confirmation
